items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: He made a set of drums for me to go play with Foster Lewis. Finally, we played, after I left Tillman. Garnup, called myself Garnup, and Foster Lewis had a pretty good band.

ctx.x: So what band did you do in the African band?
I done Foster Lewis band. Foster Lewis band. Excuse me, yeah. Foster Lewis band.
